com.esignal.jstandard.beans

Class ConnectionSettings

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.esignal.jstandard.beans.ConnectionSettings

  • public class ConnectionSettings
extends java.lang.Object
    The Purpose of this class is to hold all the settings related to establish a connection. Set all the necessary ConnectionSettings settings in order to connect to the eSignal Data server pool. The developer is responsible to call setProxyInfo() if the connection needs to be established through a proxy server. The connection host, username and password are required parameters. Since the connection port is not always required, an appropriate constructor can be used.
    Since:
    01-001-0007
    Author:
    Interactive Data Corporation
    See Also:
    ConnectionFlags

      • setConnectionTimeout

        public void setConnectionTimeout(int connectionTimeout)

        Sets a specified timeout value, in milliseconds, to be used when establishing a connection to the resource referenced by this ConnectionSettings.

        When calling ResourceManager.connect(), If a connection timeout occurs, the ResourceManager.connect() call will throw a ConnectionException with an error status code of one of the following :

        • DbcCodes.DBCAPI_ERROR.INVALIDNAME : if the resource you are trying to connect to maps to an invalid host name or ip address.
        • DbcCodes.DBCAPI_ERROR.WINSOCK : if the resource you are trying to connect to maps to an out of range network or ip address.
        • DbcCodes.DBCAPI_ERROR.SERVER_NOT_AVAILABLE : if the resource you are trying to connect to is unavailable.

        Please note that this is a global setting for the DBC ResourceManager. Setting this value will affect all subsequent calls that attempt to make a connection using the ResourceManager.connect(), call, including existing connections that might automatically reconnect upon disconnection if automatic reconnection is enabled. In addition, if the value set is less than 1000, ResourceManager.connect() call will throw a ConnectionException with an error status code of DbcCodes.DBCAPI_ERROR.INVALID_PARAM.

        Please note that this setting is ignored for the Lightweight ResourceManager. Please set connection timeouts for the LightWeight ResourceManager through the applications properties file, using lightweight specific properties.

        The default connection timeout value is set to 30,000 milliseconds.

        Refer to https://interactivedata.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/202233380-Setting-Up-the-Jstandard-properties-File for more information. for more details of application configuration through jstandard.properties.

        Parameters:
        connectionTimeout - in milliseconds.
        Since:
        01-021-0000
